title: Discord Bot: Votebot
pitch: A Discord bot that lets a competitive CS2 community vote on maps and pulls up the exact workshop version to load.
description: A Discord bot built for a Counter-Strike 2 community so players can vote on which map to play next, rating each option from 1-5 directly in Discord. Results feed into stats.geekfestclan.com, and the bot also looks up each map's Steam Workshop ID so admins can load the right version in-game without hunting for it manually.
